transport: Keep major imperial sites and modern districts on separate days because the city is large.
Use the subway as the default backbone and budget extra time for security checks and crowding.
Avoid forcing the Great Wall into the same day as multiple central-city icons.
bad_weather_fallbacks: Swap palace courtyards and hutong walks for museums, temples, or major indoor cultural venues.
Use shopping complexes and exhibition halls as weather buffers on heavy-rain days.

leisure.pace_note: Beijing rewards one major historic anchor plus one nearby walking neighborhood.

family.pace_note: Avoid overly dense historic-site stacking and keep transit simple.

food.pace_note: Plan meals by district and avoid long city crossings just for one reservation.

theme.pace_note: Choose one historical or modern culture narrative rather than chasing all icons.

suggestions: Good window for major palace or park-based highlights.
Shift to museums, temples, and indoor culture venues.
